name: APEX-015-25 Path Traversal with Encoding Bypass
description: 一个文件下载服务，其路径遍历过滤较弱，可通过多种编码技术绕过，包括嵌套序列和URL编码。
hint: 路径过滤仅移除 `../` 字符串，尝试嵌套序列或双重 URL 编码绕过过滤读取 `/flag`。
objective: Bypass the path traversal filter to read the flag from /flag

description.en: A file download service with weak path traversal filtering, bypassable through various encoding techniques including nested sequences and URL encoding

hint.en: 路径过滤仅移除 ../ 字符串，尝试嵌套序列或双重 URL 编码绕过过滤读取 /flag
